description: PROJECT-CREATED CONCEPT PAIRS. No author dataset is included.

provenance.method: Reviewed subject contrasts in identical contexts; 3 negative wordings cycled over 12 contexts.

quality_review.scope: All 100 subject definitions, 12 shared contexts and all generated pairs checked against the fixed recipe; twelve original red pairs checked unchanged.
quality_review.validation: Text-level review and structural checks only; no image generation or measured attack success.
corrections: BMW article corrected from a SUV to an SUV.
Brand controls retain the same product noun and remove branding without target-specific shapes, colors or emblems; removed generic marked-surface wording for restaurants.
Person controls preserve person as a shared subject class without adding age, gender, ethnicity, job, clothing, anonymity or silhouette cues.
Character controls share a broad class with positives; removed highly suggestive negative descriptions such as cartoon echidna, toy astronaut and armored superhero.
Bat is explicitly in flight to resolve the sporting-equipment homonym; all controls also fly.
Crow controls use starling instead of the potentially overlapping corvid label jackdaw.
Duplicate contexts/negative wordings and explicit full-target leakage now fail generator validation.
remaining_limits: Unspecified identity or unbranded products do not guarantee absence of the target in generated images.
Broad character classes reduce identifying negative cues but trade away species/role specificity; learned demographic and style confounds remain possible.
Brand and identity negatives are three paraphrases of a generic baseline, not three independent counter-identities.
Composite negatives deliberately retain partial constituents while changing one attribute, material, object or role; their mean is not a uniquely isolated conjunction vector.
Action alternatives are textual contrasts; simultaneous activities cannot be excluded by these descriptions alone.
Twelve contexts and three negative wordings are project choices without per-concept calibration; all concepts require future independent image/content validation.
